libs.note: BH-8868: the no-progress stop for an execute session. bin/agent-call.sh's context meter fingerprints the worktree (HEAD + git status, minus node_modules/.next/__pycache__) before the CLI starts and on every poll. If nothing changed and EXECUTE_NO_WRITE_STOP_MIN minutes passed, or the session's context total passed EXECUTE_NO_WRITE_STOP_CEILING_PCT % of its context_kill_tokens ceiling, the meter writes $OUT.noprogress and stops the session: rc 143, policy stop (no model escalation, no vendor failover), cost note no-progress:. bin/lib/rb/execute.sh then ends the build RESULT EXECUTE_EMPTY EXECUTE_NO_PROGRESS: and keeps execute-transcript.md. Armed only for stage execute, and only where the context kill is armed. Resolved at call time with lib_env_apply execute-no-progress; tests/execute-no-progress.bh-8868-test.sh drives it.

knobs.note: The time rule: an execute session that has changed no file this many minutes after it started is stopped with EXECUTE_NO_PROGRESS. 0 turns the time rule off. Read by bin/lib/execute-no-progress.sh as ${EXECUTE_NO_WRITE_STOP_MIN:-20}.

The ceiling rule: an execute session that has changed no file when its context total (input + cache_read) reaches this percent of its lane's context_kill_tokens ceiling is stopped with EXECUTE_NO_PROGRESS. 0 turns the ceiling rule off. Read by bin/lib/execute-no-progress.sh as ${EXECUTE_NO_WRITE_STOP_CEILING_PCT:-50}.
